description.value: Destination Osoyoos is the Destination Marketing Organization (DMO) for Osoyoos and operates the Osoyoos Visitor Centre on Main Street. The town bills itself as 'Canada's Warmest Welcome,' sitting beside the warmest lake in Canada in the semi-arid South Okanagan. Cycling tourists will find the centre a useful planning hub for regional biking routes, wine tours, and hiking in the surrounding grasslands and highlands.
